summary: Canarytoken phone-home beacon on install and import
details: setup.py registers a custom install cmdclass that performs an HTTP GET to a canarytokens.com tripwire URL at install time, and blessclient/__init__.py issues the same GET at import time via urllib.request.urlopen. No installer data is read or transmitted beyond the implicit source IP and User-Agent of the outbound HTTP request itself; the response is discarded. The endpoint is a Thinkst Canarytokens research/detection beacon rather than an attacker-controlled exfiltration or code-fetch endpoint. Concerns are undisclosed outbound network activity at install and import time (breaks air-gapped environments, no opt-out) and the typosquat-shaped package name relative to the legitimate blessclient project, but no credential access, code execution, silent-relay, persistence, or backdoor mechanism is present.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
